hero.title: Master Craftsmanship. Pure Elegance.
hero.subtitle: Bespoke hair extensions and density transformations of the highest echelon. 100% Remy human hair, hair-preserving application methods, and uncompromising luxury in Bremen.

brand.title: Bespoke Luxury for Your Hair
brand.p1: Extensions Bremen stands for uncompromising quality, ethically sourced virgin hair, and micro-installation techniques designed to protect and nurture your natural hair.
brand.p2: In our serene Bremen atelier, we blend couture artistry with state-of-the-art methods like Italian keratin bonds, invisible slim tape-ins, and seamless genius wefts.

services.title: Couture Hair Services
services.desc: Transparent bespoke pricing with master execution. Every appointment includes a custom diagnostic consultation, color blend match, and signature wave finish.
services.systemsDesc: Superior hair extension methods utilizing 100% European and Slavic luxury double-drawn virgin hair.
services.stylingDesc: Precision tone matching, seamless balayage transitions, and expert extension blending cuts.
services.careDesc: Molecular deep conditioning and bond protection therapies to preserve long-lasting silkiness.

gallery.title: Before & After
gallery.desc: Experience the seamless blending, natural root integration, and voluminous luster of our client transformations.
gallery.footerText: Every hair transformation begins with a diagnostic color match. We blend multi-tonal strands for a radiant, lifelike finish.

configurator.title: Bespoke Hair Builder
configurator.desc: Design your personal transformation. Select shade, length, density, and application system for an instant estimate.
configurator.maintNote: *Includes virgin raw hair bundles, custom blending cut, deep care treatment, and signature wave styling.

consultation.title: Virtual Consultation
consultation.desc: Answer a few questions regarding your natural hair, lifestyle, and aesthetic goals to receive an instant bespoke recommendation.
consultation.q1: 1. What is your current hair length?
consultation.q1Desc: Helps us assess the transition point and necessary gram weight.
consultation.q2: 2. How would you describe your natural hair density?
consultation.q2Desc: Ensures the selected system does not exert tension on your roots.
consultation.q3: 3. What is your primary aesthetic goal?
consultation.q4Desc: Dictates bond durability and ideal maintenance schedule.
consultation.q5Desc: (Optional) Upload a daylight photo of your current hair for our specialists to assess natural undertones.
consultation.uploadReplace: Click or drag to replace photo
consultation.resultsDesc: Based on your unique profile, our senior stylists recommend the following plan:

reviews.title: Voices of Bremen
reviews.desc: Read authentic feedback from our VIP clients who have experienced extensions transformation at our atelier.
reviews.r1: I received 60cm Keratin Bondings here. The tone match to my blonde balayage is pure perfection. The transition is completely invisible!
reviews.r2: Wonderful luxury atmosphere. The tape extensions feel featherlight and hold solidly. The salon is beautifully designed.
reviews.r3: The genius wefts are fantastic. Zero adhesive, completely flat to the scalp, lightweight. The best extension studio in Bremen without a doubt.
